hotels.title: Stylish Hampi Stay with Contemporary Comfort and Heritage Access
hotels.description: Set in the heritage-rich landscape of Hampi, Hyatt Place Hampi places you near the UNESCO-listed ruins of Vijayanagara and the stone chariot at Vittala Temple. The hotel’s contemporary rooms and suites are designed for restful stays after days spent exploring ancient palaces, temple complexes and boulder-strewn riverbanks. Start the day with breakfast at Gallery Kitchen, then return for Indian and international dishes served through the day. A fitness centre and outdoor pool provide easy downtime, while nearby Hospet offers local markets, cafés and rail links for further exploring Karnataka
